Read the given paragraph with proper intonation.5 marks
The Western Ghats are as important to the ecological and cultural life of the Nation as the Himalayas. Running from Maharashtra right down to Kerala, they are  a staggeringly rich reservoir of biodiversity. They give rise to many important rivers and are home to many significant places of Pilgrimage. Their forests ,fields and rivers sustain tens of millions of farmers, herders, fisher folk, pastoralists and artisans.
Over the past few decades, however, the ecological integrity of the Western Ghats has been subjected to sharp and sometimes savage attack. Unregulated logging, open-cast mining, large dams, and the diversion of land to real-estate barons have led to environmental degradation as well as social discount.
